abort_condition: Abort if any member produces non-finite or misaligned validation logits. Stop each member after patience=4 without improvement or 40 epochs, whichever occurs first; do not retry or add seeds. Reject if the finite ensemble result misses the acceptance threshold.
acceptance: Accept only if KuaiRand-Pure validation primary is at least 0.6054932136535645, corresponding to a gain of at least epsilon=0.002 over the observed champion. Compute and report both validation GAUC and nDCG@5 without hidden-test access.
change_summary: Replace the champion's single seed-0 prediction with the arithmetic mean of validation logits from seeds [0, 1, 2]. Keep k=16, lr=0.001, epochs=40, batch_size=8192, patience=4, and positive_weight=2.0 unchanged for every member.
hypothesis: Averaging validation logits from independently trained seed-0, seed-1, and seed-2 FMs, all using the champion configuration with positive_weight=2.0, will improve validation primary score by at least 0.002 over the single-seed champion.
rationale: The observed champion uses only seed 0. Retaining its configuration while averaging three independently initialized models tests whether reducing seed-specific variance improves ranking. This is one supported isolated change—single-model logits versus mean logits—and requires at most three 40-epoch NumPy FM fits.
title: Three-seed logit ensemble of the positive-weighted FM champion
